events.title: Your own challenges come with Clash+
events.body: Monthly challenges, weekend sprints and finale nights that run themselves: the board, the pushes and the reveal.

insights.title: The Members dashboard comes with Clash+
insights.body: Who’s training, when your gym is busiest and what your members do, week by week.

people.title: Named member insights come with Clash Pro
people.body: Who’s drifting from their usual visits by name, and what each member who shares all their training with you has been doing.

retention.title: Retention comes with Clash+
retention.body: See who’s slipping and drifting from their usual visits before they cancel, measured against each person’s own normal. Clash Pro names them.

studio.title: Studio comes with Clash Pro
studio.body: Turn your photos and clips into posts, reels and posters in minutes, filled from your events and your board.

discounts.title: Partner discounts come with Clash+
discounts.body: The discounts POWR members get from our brand partners, for buying prizes and kit for your gym. One code when you need it.
